evidence.summary: Round 4: the apply script records preflight identity, before/after rows per scope against independently computed expectations, catalogue (helpers, grants, policies, view definition, index), view timings and plans per scope (pick never executed / loops=1), heavy-path captures before and after, supervisor states and ANALYZE last_analyze, all in N0065_r4_apply_cip_output.txt; --smoke reproduces it READ ONLY. A READ ONLY perf probe locates the scoped-read cost in the pick helper (seq scan + external sort, ~0.45 s; ordered index-only scan measured at 77 ms).

rationale: An operator can see which rows each scope gets and why, and re-run the checks. Limitation: still no metric or alert on scope decisions; the scoped-read slowdown (plan-vs-executed NB 11.4 s -> 23.3 s, single run) is recorded as a follow-up, not fixed.
